name: Microsoft Excel
summary: View workbooks, read and update cell ranges, manage worksheets, append table rows, and create charts via Composio.
description: Access Microsoft 365 Excel spreadsheets stored in OneDrive or SharePoint Online using Composio-managed OAuth. Inspect workbook metadata, list and manage worksheets, read and update cell ranges, append data to tables, and generate charts.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
preferences.title: Temporary Composio API key — v1/QA
preferences.description: Temporary v1/QA key from platform.composio.dev ? Platform workspace ? API Keys. Use the same project as the Excel connection.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_USER_ID
preferences.title: Composio user ID
preferences.description: Your user identifier or entity ID configured in Composio (e.g. default, qa-user, or your email).

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_ID
preferences.title: Connected Account ID
preferences.description: Required for v1: copy the active Excel connection ID from Composio dashboard > Connected Accounts (starts with ca_).

preferences.name: DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID
preferences.title: Default workbook ID
preferences.description: OneDrive or SharePoint driveItem ID of your target Excel workbook (e.g. AF3F7AC4C1C35888!...).

preferences.name: DEFAULT_DRIVE_ID
preferences.title: Default drive ID
preferences.description: Optional OneDrive or SharePoint drive ID containing the target workbooks.

preferences.name: COMPOSIO_EXCEL_VERSION
preferences.title: Composio Excel version
preferences.description: Optional version tag for Composio Excel actions (defaults to 20261029_00).

blocks.text:
1. Log into your Composio dashboard at app.composio.dev
2. Navigate to Connected Accounts and connect your Microsoft 365 / OneDrive account under your Composio User ID.
3. Copy the active Excel connection ID from Connected Accounts (starts with ca_).
4. Enter your Composio API key (COMPOSIO_API_KEY), User ID (COMPOSIO_USER_ID), and Connected Account ID (COMPOSIO_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_ID) below.

tools.name: excel_get_workbook
tools.title: Get workbook
tools.description: Retrieve overview metadata and worksheets for an Excel workbook in OneDrive/SharePoint via Composio. Use when the user asks what sheets are in the workbook, wants to view workbook details, or inspect the default spreadsheet.

drive_id.description: Drive containing the workbook. Defaults to DEFAULT_DRIVE_ID; specify for SharePoint or another drive.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

tools.name: excel_get_worksheet
tools.title: Get worksheet
tools.description: Get details and properties of a specific worksheet in an Excel workbook by name or ID. Use when the user asks about a particular sheet's position or visibility.

worksheet_name.description: Name or ID of the worksheet to inspect.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

tools.name: excel_get_range
tools.title: Get cell range
tools.description: Read cell values and dimensions from an Excel worksheet range (e.g. 'A1:C10', 'Sheet1!B2:E6', or 'VoiceOS QA'!A1:B4) via Composio. Use when the user asks to read data, view cells, check a table, or inspect specific numbers or labels from an Excel sheet.

drive_id.description: Drive containing the workbook. Defaults to DEFAULT_DRIVE_ID; specify for SharePoint or another drive.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

worksheet_name.description: Optional worksheet name if not specified in the range address.

tools.name: excel_list_worksheets
tools.title: List worksheets
tools.description: List all worksheet tabs in an Excel workbook with their names, positions, and visibility. Use when the user asks what tabs or sheets exist in the spreadsheet.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

tools.name: excel_create_worksheet
tools.title: Create worksheet
tools.description: Create a new worksheet tab in an Excel workbook. Use when the user asks to add, insert, or create a new sheet or tab. Before confirming, resolve the default workbook with Get workbook and include its returned ID so the user sees the destination. Cancel runs no action.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

tools.name: excel_rename_worksheet
tools.title: Rename worksheet
tools.description: Rename an existing worksheet tab in an Excel workbook. Use when the user asks to rename a sheet or change its tab title. Before confirming, resolve the default workbook with Get workbook and include its returned ID so the user sees the destination. Cancel runs no action.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

tools.name: excel_delete_worksheet
tools.title: Delete worksheet
tools.description: Delete a worksheet tab from an Excel workbook. This action permanently deletes sheet data. Use when the user specifically requests to delete or remove a sheet. Before confirming, resolve the default workbook with Get workbook and include its returned ID so the user sees the destination. Cancel runs no action.

worksheet_name.description: Name of the worksheet to permanently delete.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

children.text: Permanently deletes this worksheet and its data. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: excel_update_range
tools.title: Update cell range
tools.description: Write or update cell values in an Excel worksheet range (e.g. 'A1:B2', 'Sheet1!A1:B2', or ''VoiceOS QA'!A1:B2'). Use when the user asks to write numbers, set values, or update cells in a sheet. Before confirming, resolve the default workbook with Get workbook and include its returned ID so the user sees the destination. Cancel runs no action.

range.description: Target cell range address (e.g. 'A1:B2', 'Sheet1!A1:B2', or ''VoiceOS QA'!A1:B2').

values.description: 2D array of values or rows of cell values to update.

worksheet_name.description: Optional worksheet name if not prefixed in range address.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

tools.name: excel_add_table_rows
tools.title: Add table rows
tools.description: Append new data rows to an existing Excel table (e.g. 'ReleaseQATable' on 'Release QA Verified'). Use when the user asks to insert or append rows to a table. Before confirming, resolve the default workbook with Get workbook and include its returned ID so the user sees the destination. Cancel runs no action.

table_id.description: Table ID or table name in Excel (e.g. 'ReleaseQATable' or a table GUID). In Excel and Microsoft Graph, the table name functions directly as the table ID, viewable in Excel under Table Design -> Table Name.

table_name.description: Name of the target Excel table (e.g. 'ReleaseQATable'). Will be mapped to table_id under Microsoft Graph.

rows.description: 2D array of row data to append or JSON string (e.g. [['2025-06-01', 'QA Verified', 'Passed']]). Mapped to values for Excel.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.

worksheet_name.description: Worksheet containing the table (e.g. 'Release QA Verified').

tools.name: excel_create_chart
tools.title: Create chart
tools.description: Create an Excel chart (e.g. ColumnClustered, Line, Pie) from a range of cell data via Composio. Use when the user asks to create, insert, or plot a chart or graph. Before confirming, resolve the default workbook with Get workbook and include its returned ID so the user sees the destination. Cancel runs no action.

range.description: Source cell range for chart data (e.g. 'A1:C5', 'Sheet1!A1:D10', or ''VoiceOS QA'!A1:B4').

worksheet_name.description: Worksheet where chart will be created.

workbook_id.description: Workbook driveItem ID. Blank or omitted uses DEFAULT_WORKBOOK_ID from Setup. When preparing a write, call Get workbook to resolve the default and include its returned ID so the confirmation shows the target.
